unsupported_commands_not_posting.detail: Metrics flags only on 'run' subparser. Other commands have no --metrics flag, so they cannot trigger metrics. However, pipeline_hook.py has a fallback '1/0' count for non-run commands. Since no CLI wiring exists for those commands, this is currently safe but incomplete.
